name: Andron's Payment to Jediga
label: Quest
description: Andron's Payment to Jediga: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Here... Take... This to Jediga. Good luck to ya!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you met with Andron yet? He rarely leaves Undercity, so I don't think it'd be too hard to find him.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Haha! What'd you tell him when you delivered the tablet, friend? He overpaid us way too much! Not that I'm complaining. Did you tell him the deal changed? Or was he drunk again?
Doesn't matter... Here, take an extra share also.
